_meta.purpose: Hand-curated, one-time annotation of network structure needed by the propagation module and the event injector. Not scraped -- there is no clean public dataset for this, so it was assembled from general, well-documented facts about these specific real routes.
sources: Konkan Railway is publicly documented as a largely single-line route with passing loops, and publishes an official monsoon timetable each year with speed restrictions -- this is why the Mandovi Express sections below are marked single_line + high monsoon risk.

Northern plains routes (Delhi-Ambala-Ludhiana-Amritsar corridor) are widely documented as the most fog-affected stretch of Indian Railways in winter (Dec-Jan) -- this is why the Shatabdi sections below carry winter_fog risk.
Crew/loco changeover points are illustrative assumptions for demo purposes (marked accordingly), not verified against a live crew-roster system.

connecting_trains.note: Illustrative: if 12301 arrives badly late into NDLS, a same-day onward Shatabdi (12013) sharing crew/platform resources at NDLS is used to demo downstream propagation.
